question: Within a radius of 180 kilometers, where can I locate restaurant on the journey from Captain Mike's Fun Park, Bridgman, MI to McCormick Bridgehouse & Chicago River Museum, Chicago, IL?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_Intersects( geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Captain Mike\'s Fun Park%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%McCormick Bridgehouse & Chicago River Museum%' LIMIT 1 ) )::geography, 180000 -- 180 kilometers in meters ) );
